question: When people talk to AI about stress or sadness, how should we judge whether the AI is helping them?
reflection: Good tests built with care experts can help AI support people gently, while knowing when to point them to real human help.

sources.subject: Your next business call could be Gemini

one_line: OpenAI publishes an open test for how chatbots handle mental health conversations, as assistants begin to phone businesses for users.

top_stories.title: An open test for mental health conversations
top_stories.what: OpenAI released an open benchmark of about 1,200 synthetic conversations, built with more than 80 clinicians in 19 languages, covering everyday stress through to crisis.
top_stories.why: This gives health and wellbeing services a ready starting point to check AI tools, including in Arabic, before using them with the public.

top_stories.title: Assistants now phone businesses for you
top_stories.what: Google's Gemini can reportedly call local businesses, wait on hold and handle bookings for paying US users on its newest phones, with a live transcript.
top_stories.why: When customers send agents instead of calling themselves, service centres will need new rules and staff guidance.

top_stories.title: White House reportedly delays UK model testing
top_stories.what: The US government has reportedly asked OpenAI and Anthropic to hold back new models from British safety testers until a US security review is done.
top_stories.why: If allies cannot test models early, countries relying on outside evaluations may need their own testing capacity.

saudi_lens.text: The mental health benchmark covers many languages, so Saudi health bodies could check how well it reflects Arabic and local norms before using it to judge chatbots.

idea.title: Arabic wellbeing chatbot review
idea.pitch: Adapt open mental health test conversations to Saudi Arabic and cultural context, then score popular chatbots with local clinicians.
idea.first_step: Review a sample of the benchmark conversations with two local clinicians and note what needs adapting.

idea_kids.title: Feelings helper cards
idea_kids.pitch: A card set that helps children name a feeling, pick a calming step and choose a trusted adult to talk to.
idea_kids.first_step: Draw eight simple feeling faces and write one calming idea for each.
